# The invoice, attached to the CAD payment that overpays it, declaring the
# 100.00 USD it leaves the customer.
#
# Every figure here is the document's own money: the split the retarget moves
# is the −200.00 USD receivable side, 274.00 being its CAD *value* rather than
# its amount. So `amount: 200` and `prepayment: 100` are both USD, and the
# fall-short check compares like with like. (The mixed-currency case, where it
# declines to compare at all, needs a transaction whose other side is in
# neither currency — pinned directly in `test_what_a_payment_can_take.py`.)
invoice "INV-FX-CAD-BANK"
	customer_id: "C-FX"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-FX-CAD-BANK"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 200
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		txn_guid: "TXN_GUID"
		prepayment: 100
		memo: "Payment for INV-FX-CAD-BANK"
